patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Clay share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Clay's shape. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; Clay leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Clay share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris.
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs Clay-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Clay's motion (GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecti)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
